assessment.comments: The clean review is confirmed by direct source comparison. The source asks whether, for every k ≠ 1, infinitely many natural numbers n satisfy 2^n ≡ k (mod n); the Lean statement has the same quantifier scope and predicate. Allowing n = 0 or n = 1 does not change infinitude, since these contribute at most finitely many exceptional values. The cited module also builds successfully with `lake --wfail`. No source mismatch or checked mathematical counterexample was found, and no repair was proposed.
